response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned staff-level generalist with 15+ years shipping production software across web, backend, embedded and high-throughput data services, plus recent hands-on work with MCP code generators and agentic developer tooling — which maps to one niche part of the role. However, the core requirement of 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions is not met: there is no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, multi-agent frameworks, or ML systems on cloud platforms beyond roughly a year of adjacent agent-infrastructure work. Python is absent from the skills list, and cloud depth is limited to AWS CDK on a pricing platform. He could be a strong fit for a platform/infra engineering role, but as a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI Engineer he would be a stretch hire requiring a deep technical screen on AI systems.
strengths: 15+ years senior/staff engineering across full stack, TypeScript, and distributed systems
Current hands-on MCP and agentic workflow tooling experience
Strong engineering-excellence and mentoring track record (TDD, CI/CD, workshops, OSS)
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of production AI/GenAI delivery
No RAG, vector DB, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent framework experience listed
Limited Python and shallow cloud/AI platform depth (AWS CDK only)

key_factors.factor: Deep senior/staff engineering breadth and delivery record
Weak Python and cloud AI platform coverage
